name: General requirements
note: Sets the architecture rather than asking for disclosures — double materiality, reporting boundary, value chain, time horizons, and how to apply the topical standards. Nothing is filed against it directly, which is why its disclosure count is zero, but every judgement in this tool is made under it.

name: General disclosures
note: Applies in full regardless of the materiality assessment — it is the one standard a preparer cannot screen out. Covers basis of preparation, governance, strategy and business model, and the impact/risk/opportunity management process itself.

name: Climate change
note: In practice assessed as material by almost every preparer, and the only topical standard where omission attracts an explicit explanation requirement. Includes the transition plan, gross Scope 1, 2 and 3, removals and carbon credits, internal carbon pricing, and anticipated financial effects.
